ambiguityRegister.question: P2 pipeline structure — Plan A (per-task independent pipeline) vs Plan B (keep existing structure)?
ambiguityRegister.impact: Phase 5 wall clock time: max(task review time) vs sum of all tasks
ambiguityRegister.recommendedAnswer: Plan A: pipeline(tasks, enrichStage, reviewStage) — two-stage form where enrichStage is no-op and reviewStage runs spec→code→adversarial per task independently. Wall clock ≈ max(single task spec+code+adversarial time) + overhead
ambiguityRegister.decision: Plan A (corrected to two-stage form per Phase 3 review)

ambiguityRegister.question: Guardrail granularity — hard numeric limits vs soft constraints?
ambiguityRegister.impact: Whether agents re-read files 12+ times (observed in session 36064b31 task-02)
ambiguityRegister.recommendedAnswer: Option 1: 5 file reads max, no build/test/grep, 3 thinking blocks max

ambiguityRegister.question: Model tiering — Haiku or Sonnet for spec review with injected context?

ambiguityRegister.recommendedAnswer: Haiku default for spec review; Sonnet when Quick Gate marks task as high-risk (missing >=2 expectedEvidence)
ambiguityRegister.decision: Haiku default, Sonnet upgrade for high-risk

ambiguityRegister.question: Implement all P0+P1+P2 this run or split into phases?

ambiguityRegister.recommendedAnswer: All in one run — P2 structural refactor is a one-time change

assumptionLedger.assumption: With injected spec text + file contents, Haiku is sufficient for spec compliance review (checklist-style)
assumptionLedger.evidence: Qodo benchmark: Haiku 4.5 Thinking outperformed Sonnet 4.5 on code review quality (7.29 vs 6.60) for single-pass reviews
assumptionLedger.correctionPath: If spec review false-negative rate increases, upgrade to Sonnet for tasks with >3 file dependencies

assumptionLedger.assumption: pipeline(tasks, enrichStage, reviewStage) with per-task independent execution won't cause file conflicts
assumptionLedger.evidence: Task files are generally disjoint in well-structured plans; current session's 5 tasks had distinct file sets
assumptionLedger.correctionPath: File-overlap check at enrichment time + serialization for shared-file tasks. Master agent logs warning, enrichment step documents overlap in task._sharedFilesWarning.

assumptionLedger.assumption: 5 file reads is sufficient when spec + file contents are injected into the agent prompt
assumptionLedger.evidence: task-01 completed spec review in 111s with 7 calls; injected context should reduce this further
assumptionLedger.correctionPath: If found insufficient, adjust to 8 file reads
